page.overview:
Who is Tidjii O'Garee?

Tidjii was born into a tomb robbing family on Hagal. As a child, she met Phin O'Garee. Phin's father, who had not conducted the necessary research beforehard, led them in an attempted robbery of a tomb that belonged to a formidable family. Now being hunted, Tidjii and Phin travelled to the furthest planet they could afford to travel to, Arrakis. They later married and had five children; Phin Jr., Phaedra, Brie, Sally and Koda.

Tidjii was approached by the Prisoner at her stall in Arrakeen. She discussed the positive and negative aspects of the War of Assassins and recalled the breakdown of the betrothal between Ariste Atreides and Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen. She also told them of the strange things she and her family would find in the deep desert, such as when Sally found a resupply shuttle from Kirana III.
